# MyDailyDevTools

> Essential developer tools for everyday tasks. Fast, free, and privacy-focused web tools including JSON formatter, URL encoder, Base64 converter, hash generator, password generator, text diff checker, UUID generator, QR code generator, and delimiter converter.

## Overview

MyDailyDevTools provides a comprehensive suite of developer utilities that run entirely in the browser. No data is sent to servers, ensuring complete privacy. All tools are free to use and require no registration.

## Tool Documentation

### JSON Formatter (/json-formatter)

Formats, validates, and minifies JSON data with syntax highlighting and error detection.

**Features:**
- Format messy JSON with proper indentation
- Validate JSON syntax with detailed error messages
- Minify JSON to reduce size
- Copy formatted output with one click
- Handle large JSON files efficiently

**Example Use Cases:**
- Format API responses for readability
- Validate JSON configuration files
- Minify JSON for production use
- Debug JSON parsing errors

### URL Encoder/Decoder (/url-encoder)

Safely encode and decode URLs for web use, handling special characters and Unicode.

**Features:**
- Encode text to URL-safe format
- Decode URL-encoded strings
- Handle Unicode characters properly
- Support for query parameters
- Real-time conversion

**Example Use Cases:**
- Encode query parameters for API calls
- Decode encoded URLs from logs
- Prepare URLs for sharing
- Handle international characters in URLs

### Base64 Encoder/Decoder (/base64)

Convert between text/binary data and Base64 format for data transmission and storage.

**Features:**
- Encode text to Base64
- Decode Base64 to text
- Support for file encoding
- Handle binary data
- URL-safe Base64 variant

**Example Use Cases:**
- Encode credentials for Basic Authentication
- Embed images in CSS/HTML
- Transmit binary data in JSON
- Decode Base64 data from APIs

### Hash Generator (/hash-generator)

Generate cryptographic hashes using multiple algorithms for data integrity and security.

**Features:**
- MD5 hash generation (128-bit)
- SHA-256 hash generation (256-bit)
- SHA-512 hash generation (512-bit)
- Real-time hashing as you type
- Copy hash with one click

**Example Use Cases:**
- Verify file integrity
- Generate checksums for downloads
- Create unique identifiers
- Password hashing (for comparison)

### Password Generator (/password-generator)

Create strong, secure passwords with customizable criteria.

**Features:**
- Adjustable length (4-128 characters)
- Include/exclude uppercase letters
- Include/exclude lowercase letters
- Include/exclude numbers
- Include/exclude special characters
- Exclude ambiguous characters option
- Generate multiple passwords at once

**Example Use Cases:**
- Create secure account passwords
- Generate API keys
- Create temporary passwords
- Bulk password generation for testing

### Text Diff Checker (/text-diff)

Compare two texts side-by-side with visual highlighting of differences.

**Features:**
- Line-by-line comparison
- Character-level diff highlighting
- Added/removed/modified line indicators
- Unified or split view modes
- Handle large text files

**Example Use Cases:**
- Compare code versions
- Review document changes
- Verify configuration differences
- Check log file variations

### UUID Generator (/uuid-generator)

Generate universally unique identifiers (UUID v4) for various applications.

**Features:**
- Generate single UUID v4
- Bulk generation (up to 100 at once)
- Multiple format options (uppercase, lowercase, no hyphens)
- Copy individual or all UUIDs
- Guaranteed uniqueness

**Example Use Cases:**
- Database primary keys
- Session identifiers
- Temporary file names
- API request IDs

### QR Code Generator (/qr-generator)

Create QR codes for text, URLs, or any data with customizable size.

**Features:**
- Generate QR codes for any text
- Adjustable size (100-500 pixels)
- Error correction levels
- Download as PNG image
- Real-time preview

**Example Use Cases:**
- Share WiFi credentials
- Create mobile-friendly links
- Generate contact information
- Encode configuration data

### Delimiter Converter (/delimiter-converter)

Convert between different delimiter formats with automatic detection, perfect for Excel data.

**Features:**
- Auto-detect input delimiter (NEW!)
- Convert between CSV, TSV, pipe, semicolon, etc.
- Handle Excel copy/paste seamlessly
- Custom delimiter support
- Preserve quoted fields
- Download converted files

**Example Use Cases:**
- Convert Excel data to CSV
- Change delimiter for database imports
- Process data from different systems
- Clean up inconsistent data formats

## Technical Implementation

### Privacy Features
- No server-side processing
- No data logging or storage
- No cookies without consent
- No external API calls for tools
- Local browser storage only

### Performance Optimizations
- Client-side processing using Web APIs
- Efficient algorithms for large data
- Lazy loading of tool components
- Optimized for mobile devices
- Fast page loads with Next.js

### Browser Compatibility
- Chrome 90+
- Firefox 88+
- Safari 14+
- Edge 90+
- Mobile browsers supported

## GDPR Compliance

The site is fully compliant with GDPR and Dutch DPA requirements:
- Explicit cookie consent required
- No cookie walls
- Full functionality without tracking
- Clear privacy and cookie policies
- User rights respected

## Integration Examples

### Using with Development Workflows

1. **API Development**: Use JSON formatter to debug API responses
2. **Database Work**: Convert Excel exports to CSV for imports
3. **Security**: Generate hashes for file verification
4. **Frontend**: Encode data for URL parameters

### Automation Tips

While the tools are web-based, you can:
- Bookmark specific tools for quick access
- Use browser developer tools for automation
- Create bookmarklets for common tasks
- Use keyboard shortcuts where available
